blurb:
Drink•Eat•Walk small group evening food & drink neighborhood walking tours explore beyond tourist Washington in to the streets & places we DC locals hang out in, so you can experience the true flavor of the city. 

This local neighborhood Washington DC food tour dives into two of our city's most beloved areas — Dupont Circle's streets are filled with stately embassies, charming row homes, and fabulous people; Adams Morgan is DC's most eclectic neighborhood, bursting with sights, smells, and flavors from around the world.

We stop for eats & drinks in six different places, learning about the communities and culture that built and sustain DC in each one. In between, we'll walk the streets in a way that gives you a true feel for each neighborhood.

This tour is all about having a great group experience & solo travelers are definitely welcome. We'll get to know each other as we eat, drink, & learn our way into the night in this great city we locals call home.

Food tour DC like a local!
